data.description: Agent depicted in the cataloged item.
Agent holding copyright to the original works of authorship which is fixed in a tangible form of expression as referenced in the record.

Agent responsible for collecting a cataloged item. May also apply to an agent who assembled a collection of objects but did not necessarily collect or prepare the objects (e.g., collection of materials that were acquired through exchange, purchase, or other means).
Agent responsible for the existence or availability of an object or work (e.g. artist, author, publisher, or contributor). This term may be specified or explained further with remarks.
Agent who prepared the cataloged record, whether biological, cultural, or geological item or mineral.
Agent responsible for separating microorganisms or components from samples resulting in the current cataloged record.

metadata.label: Collection Object: Agent Roles
metadata.description: The fundamental role of an agent associated with a cataloged item. Multiple agents and roles may be associated with a single record.
